repos.description: CowAgent是基于大模型的超级AI助理，能主动思考和任务规划、访问操作系统和外部资源、创造和执行Skills、拥有长期记忆并不断成长。同时支持飞书、钉钉、企业微信应用、微信公众号、网页等接入，可选择OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/ Qwen/GLM/Kimi/LinkAI，能处理文本、语音、图片和文件，可快速搭建个人AI助手和企业数字员工。
repos.summary_zh: CowAgent 是基于大模型的超级AI助理，支持主动任务规划、多模态交互（文本/语音/图片/文件）、长期记忆与技能系统，可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信、微信公众号等多平台，兼容OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek等主流模型，适用于个人AI助手与企业数字员工场景。
repos.summary_en: CowAgent is a super AI assistant based on large language models, supporting autonomous task planning, multimodal interaction (text/audio/image/files), long-term memory, and a skill system. It integrates with platforms like Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and WeChat Official Accounts, compatible with OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek models, ideal for personal AI assistants and enterprise digital employees.

repos.description: 🤖 可 DIY 的 多模态 AI 聊天机器人 | 🚀 快速接入 微信、 QQ、Telegram、等聊天平台 | 🦈支持DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI | 工作流系统、网页搜索、AI画图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话 |
repos.summary_zh: Kirara AI 是一款可自定义的多模态 AI 聊天机器人，支持快速接入微信、QQ、Telegram 等主流聊天平台，兼容 DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI 等主流大模型。具备工作流系统、网页搜索、AI 绘图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话等功能，提供 WebUI 和 Docker 部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Kirara AI is a customizable multimodal AI chatbot that supports rapid integration with WeChat, QQ, Telegram, and other major messaging platforms. It integrates with leading LLMs including DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI. Features include workflow systems, web search, AI image generation, persona tuning, virtual maid mode, voice interaction, and offers both WebUI and Docker deployment options.

repos.description: 🧑‍🚀 全世界最好的LLM资料总结（多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练、模型推理、o1 模型、MCP、小语言模型、视觉语言模型） | Summary of the world's best LLM resources.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是全网最全面的大语言模型（LLM）资源汇总，涵盖多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练与推理等全链路技术方向，持续更新维护，为研究者与开发者提供权威的一站式学习与实践指南。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the most comprehensive collection of LLM resources globally, covering multimodal generation, agents, code assistance, AI review, data processing, model training and inference, and more. It serves as an authoritative one-stop guide for researchers and developers, continuously updated.

repos.description: One UI is all done with chatgpt web, midjourney, gpts,suno,luma,runway,viggle,flux,ideogram,realtime,pika,udio; Simultaneous support  Web / PWA / Linux / Win / MacOS platform
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个集成 ChatGPT、MidJourney、Suno、Luma、Runway、Viggle、Flux、Ideogram、Pika 等多模态 AI 服务的统一前端界面，支持 Web/PWA/Linux/Win/MacOS 全平台运行，提供文生图、图生视频、语音识别、Gpts 多模态交互等功能，并支持自定义 API Key 与 one-api/new-api 部署。
repos.summary_en: This project is a unified frontend interface integrating multiple AI services including ChatGPT, MidJourney, Suno, Luma, Runway, Viggle, Flux, Ideogram, and Pika. It supports multimodal generation (text-to-image/video/audio), browser-based ASR, GPTs, and runs on Web/PWA/Linux/Win/MacOS. Features custom API keys, one-api/new-api deployment, and local image storage.

repos.description: 🎒 飞书  ×（GPT-4 + GPT-4V + DALL·E-3 + Whisper）=  飞一般的工作体验  🚀 语音对话、角色扮演、多话题讨论、图片创作、表格分析、文档导出 🚀
repos.summary_zh: 飞书 × OpenAI 深度集成工具，支持 GPT-4、GPT-4V、DALL·E-3 和 Whisper，提供语音对话、图片生成、表格分析、角色扮演等功能，无缝嵌入飞书生态，支持多场景 AI 工作流，提升企业协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Feishu OpenAI integrates GPT-4, GPT-4V, DALL·E-3, and Whisper into Feishu, enabling voice chat, image generation, table analysis, role-playing, and more. It enhances enterprise collaboration with AI-powered workflows, supporting private deployment, cloud functions, and Docker.

repos.description: iFlow cli is a comprehensive command-line intelligence that embeds in your terminal, analyzes your repositories, does coding tasks, interprets your needs across contexts, and boosts efficiency by performing tasks from simple file operations to complex workflow automation.
repos.summary_zh: iFlow CLI 是一款终端内嵌的 AI 智能助手，支持自然语言交互、代码仓库分析、多模态输入及复杂工作流自动化。集成 iFlow 开放市场，一键安装 MCP 工具与子代理，提供免费版多模态模型（如 Kimi K2、Qwen3 Coder）支持，具备计划模式、任务压缩、插件扩展等高级功能，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: iFlow CLI is an AI-powered terminal assistant that analyzes codebases, executes coding tasks, and automates workflows via natural language. It integrates free multimodal models (e.g., Kimi K2, Qwen3 Coder), supports SubAgents and MCP tools from its Open Market, and offers advanced features like plan mode, context compression, and plugin support for enhanced developer productivity.

repos.description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Deep Research 是一个基于 AI 的极速深度研究工具，支持多 LLM 模型（如 Gemini、OpenAI、Anthropic 等）和主流搜索引擎，可在约 2 分钟内生成高质量研究报告。采用 Thinking 与 Task 模型协同工作，支持本地知识库构建、知识图谱可视化、内容编辑与历史记录管理，所有数据均本地处理，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Deep Research is an AI-powered tool for lightning-fast in-depth research, supporting multiple LLMs (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic) and search engines. It generates comprehensive reports in ~2 minutes using Thinking and Task models, with local knowledge base, knowledge graph, content editing, and full privacy via on-device processing.

repos.description: 将视频瞬间转化为手绘故事 Turn Video Moments into Hand-Drawn Stories
repos.summary_zh: ClipSketch AI 是一款专为视频创作者设计的 AI 驱动内容创作工具，支持解析 Bilibili 和小红书视频链接，实现帧级精准标记，并借助 Google Gemini 多模态模型将精彩瞬间一键转化为手绘风格故事板，自动生成适配社交媒体的爆款文案，涵盖角色融合、封面生成和批量精修功能。
repos.summary_en: ClipSketch AI is an AI-powered content creation tool for video creators, enabling frame-level tagging of Bilibili and Xiaohongshu videos, transforming key moments into hand-drawn storyboards via Google Gemini's multimodal models, and auto-generating social media captions, character fusion, cover images, and batch-enhanced visuals.

repos.summary_zh: Snippai 是一款基于先进 AI 算法的智能截图工具，支持公式识别（转 LaTeX）、文本提取、表格转 Markdown、图像分析、代码理解、颜色检测和多语言翻译等功能，显著提升截图处理效率与智能化水平。
repos.summary_en: Snippai is an AI-powered intelligent snipping tool that leverages advanced algorithms to recognize formulas (LaTeX conversion), extract text, convert tables to Markdown, analyze images, understand code, detect colors, and translate text in any language—enhancing productivity through smart screenshot processing.

repos.description: OpenAI-compatible API for Gemini Business with multi-account load balancing and multimodal capabilities (image/video generation, file parsing) | 将 Gemini Business 转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡及多模态能力（图像生成、视频生成、解析文件）
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Business2API 将 Gemini Business 转换为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡、自动化注册登录、多模态文件解析（100+格式）、图像/视频生成及流式输出。提供 Docker 部署、管理面板和 PostgreSQL/SQLite 存储，适用于个人技术研究与非商业场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Business2API converts Gemini Business into an OpenAI-compatible API with multi-account load balancing, automated account management, multimodal file parsing (100+ formats), image/video generation, and streaming responses. Features Docker deployment, admin panel, and PostgreSQL/SQLite persistence for non-commercial research use.

repos.description: 【新增智能体模式】安卓端全场景GPT助手，可用音量键唤起并进行语音交流，支持联网、拍照、模板、附件解析、智能体模式等 | GPT assistant for Android, activated via volume keys for voice interaction, supporting features such as networking, taking photos, templates, parsing PDF and Office documents, and agent mode.
repos.summary_zh: 安卓端全场景GPT助手，支持音量键快捷唤醒与语音交互，具备联网查询、拍照识别、模板定制及PDF/Office文档解析功能。通过OpenAI API提供智能服务，支持多模态输入与连续对话，适配国内第三方转发接口，完全开源免费。
repos.summary_en: A full-scenario GPT assistant for Android, activated via volume keys for voice interaction. Supports web search, photo capture, template customization, and parsing of PDF/Office documents. Powered by OpenAI API with multimodal input and continuous chat, compatible with third-party forwarding services, fully open-source and free.

repos.description: An open-source AI visualization tool that transforms natural language into Mind Maps, Mermaid diagrams, and Echarts. Turn your ideas into structured visuals instantly.
repos.summary_zh: DeepDiagram AI 是一个开源智能可视化平台，基于 Agentic AI 和多智能体协同架构，将自然语言及多模态输入自动转换为专业级图表。支持思维导图、流程图、数据图表、架构图、Mermaid 语法图和信息图六大类型，具备上下文感知路由与 XML 结构化输出能力，适用于知识管理、数据分析与系统建模等场景。
repos.summary_en: DeepDiagram AI is an open-source intelligent visualization platform powered by Agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration, transforming natural language and multimodal inputs into professional diagrams. It supports six diagram types—mind maps, flowcharts, data charts, architecture diagrams, Mermaid syntax diagrams, and infographics—with context-aware routing, XML-structured output, and interactive editing capabilities for knowledge management, data storytelling, and system design.

repos.description: 基于chatgpt-next-web，增加了midjourney绘画功能，支持mj-plus的ai换脸和局部重绘，接入了stable-diffusion，支持oss，支持接入fastgpt知识库，支持suno，支持luma。支持dall-e-3、gpt-4-vision-preview、whisper、tts等多模态模型，支持gpt-4-all，支持GPTs商店。新增加了支持后台管理的版本，包括登录注册，平台模型apikey管理，套餐管理，消息保存等。
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT-Next-Web-Pro 是基于 ChatGPT-Next-Web 的深度增强版本，集成多模态 AI 能力，支持 MidJourney 绘画、Stable Diffusion、DALL-E-3、Suno 音乐生成、Luma 视频创作及 GPTs 商店，同时提供无后台轻量版与带用户管理、API 密钥管控、套餐订阅的有后台企业版，覆盖绘图、语音、文件解析等全场景 AI 应用。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT-Next-Web-Pro is an enhanced fork of ChatGPT-Next-Web, integrating multimodal AI capabilities including MidJourney painting, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E-3, Suno music generation, Luma video creation, and GPTs Store. It offers both a lightweight 'no-backend' version and a full-featured 'with-backend' enterprise edition with user management, API key control, subscription plans, and support for file parsing, OCR, TTS, and cloud storage.

repos.description: 🚀 MiniMax大模型海螺AI逆向API【特长：超自然语音】，支持MiniMax Text-01、MiniMax-VL-01模型，支持高速流式输出、语音合成、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为MiniMax海螺AI提供逆向API服务，支持MiniMax-Text-01和MiniMax-VL-01模型，具备高速流式输出、语音合成与识别、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析及多轮对话能力。零配置部署，支持多路token并发，自动清理会话痕迹，接口兼容ChatGPT，适用于测试与个人使用。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for MiniMax Hailuo AI, supporting MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 models. It features high-speed streaming output, speech synthesis/ASR, web search, document analysis, image parsing, and multi-turn conversations. Zero-configuration deployment, multi-token concurrency, session auto-cleanup, and full ChatGPT compatibility. For testing only; commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: 灵匠 - AI 驱动的创意内容生成平台，支持 AI 图像生成、视频生成、角色项目管理、可视化工作流编辑等功能。
repos.summary_zh: 灵匠(SoulArtisan)是一个AI驱动的创意内容生成平台，集成文生图、图生图、视频生成及角色管理功能。采用Spring Boot+React技术栈，支持可视化工作流编辑与多租户管理，通过节点化设计实现从剧本到视频的端到端创作流程，配备点数系统和云存储等生产级特性。
repos.summary_en: SoulArtisan is an AI-powered creative content generation platform featuring text-to-image, image-to-video, and character management. Built with Spring Boot and React, it offers visual workflow editing via node-based design for end-to-end creation from scripts to videos, complete with point systems and cloud storage for production use.

repos.summary_zh: XS-VLM-OCR 是一款基于大模型的多模态 OCR 工具，支持 Qwen、GLM、PaddleOCR、Gemini 等主流视觉语言模型。它不仅能识别文字，还能理解上下文，实现表格提取、手写识别、文档翻译、题目解答和结构化整理等功能，提供截图自动识别、批量处理和跨平台桌面端体验。
repos.summary_en: XS-VLM-OCR is a multimodal OCR tool powered by large language models, supporting Qwen, GLM, PaddleOCR, Gemini, and other vision-language models. It goes beyond text recognition to understand context, enabling table extraction, handwriting recognition, document translation, problem-solving, and content structuring. Features include screenshot auto-capture, batch processing, and cross-platform desktop support.
